skill.name: makeitsay
skill.description: Change or remove the words in a screenshot or photo with MakeItSay and keep the original font, colour and background. Use when the user wants to edit text in an image, fix a typo or price on a sign, menu, poster or UI screenshot, translate the lettering in a photo, or remove a line of text from an image. Needs a MakeItSay API key in MAKEITSAY_API_KEY.
skill.summary: Replace or remove image text through MakeItSay while preserving its original appearance.
skill.author: MakeItSay

content.user_title: Replace Text in Images with MakeItSay
content.value_statement: Changing image text manually can require rebuilding fonts and backgrounds. This skill guides MakeItSay edits that replace or remove selected lines while preserving their appearance.
actual_capabilities: Scan PNG and JPG images for text lines and their bounding boxes.
Replace up to 20 text lines per image, with up to 200 characters per line.
Remove a text line by providing an empty replacement.
Use location hints to distinguish repeated text within an image.
Submit edits through connected MCP tools or the authenticated HTTP API.
Check credits, poll edit status, and retrieve an original-size PNG through a temporary result link.
limitations: Requires a MakeItSay API key and network access; successful edits cost one credit per image.
Accepts PNG or JPG images with sides from 64 to 4096 pixels, up to 8.4 megapixels and 10 MB.
Refuses identity, official, and financial documents, including receipts and invoices.
Result links expire after one hour; scan quotas and request limits also apply.

use_cases.title: Update Menu Prices
use_cases.description: Replace quoted prices in a menu image while keeping the surrounding design.

use_cases.title: Revise Interface Screenshots
use_cases.description: Correct interface copy in a screenshot for a design review without rebuilding the original screen.

use_cases.title: Localize Poster Text
use_cases.description: Replace poster lettering with supplied translations and identify repeated lines using location hints.

prompt_templates.title: Correct One Word
prompt_templates.prompt: In the attached poster, replace 'Welcom' with 'Welcome'. Keep the surrounding image unchanged and return the edited PNG.

prompt_templates.title: Inspect Unclear Text
prompt_templates.prompt: Scan the attached menu and show the detected lines. Confirm the intended line with me before changing its price to '$14'.

prompt_templates.title: Target Repeated Text
prompt_templates.prompt: Replace only the bottom 'SALE' with 'FINAL SALE' in the attached poster. Remove 'Today only' and leave the top 'SALE' unchanged.

prompt_templates.title: Coordinate Multiple Edits
prompt_templates.prompt: Check credits for the three attached screenshots. Confirm the cost, apply my supplied replacements, poll pending edits, and download completed PNGs before expiry. Reuse idempotency keys for HTTP retries.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: multiple images and retry handling

output_examples.input: Change '$12' to '$14' in the attached menu image.
output_examples.output: Illustrative completion: The menu price is now '$14'. The edited PNG retains the original image dimensions.

output_examples.input: Remove 'Draft' from the bottom of this poster.
output_examples.output: Illustrative completion: The bottom 'Draft' line has been removed. Download the edited PNG before its result link expires in one hour.

best_practices: Use exact source text and location hints; scan only when the visible wording is uncertain.
Upload only images you may share with MakeItSay, and keep the API key out of chat and saved files.
Check credits before batches, reuse HTTP idempotency keys for retries, and download results before their links expire.
anti_patterns: Do not attempt to bypass refusals for identity, official, or financial documents.
Do not repeatedly resubmit edits with new idempotency keys or poll without delays.
Do not submit unsupported images or assume temporary result links are permanent storage.

faq.question: What do I need before using this skill?
faq.answer: Set MAKEITSAY_API_KEY for your MakeItSay account. Use a connected MakeItSay MCP server or the documented HTTP API.

faq.question: How much does an edit cost?
faq.answer: A successful edit costs one credit per image, regardless of changed lines. Failed edits and missing-text errors are not charged.

faq.question: Can it remove text rather than replace it?
faq.answer: Yes. An empty replacement removes the selected line. A location hint can distinguish identical lines.

faq.question: Which images are supported?
faq.answer: Use PNG or JPG images with sides from 64 to 4096 pixels, up to 8.4 megapixels and 10 MB.

faq.question: Are scans free and unlimited?
faq.answer: Scans are free but limited to 30 per hour and 100 per day per account.

faq.question: Does this skill process images locally?
faq.answer: No. Images are submitted to MakeItSay for processing. Edited PNG links remain available for one hour.
